# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

The iPhone 17 supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging, so a 25W bank charges it faster than a 15W one. Slimmer banks are usually 5,000mAh and cap at 15W or less.

## Slimmest 5,000mAh: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)
- It's 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, with Qi2 15W wireless and 20W wired. Anker lists the iPhone 17 series as compatible.
- 9to5Mac's reviewer says it's the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery, feels premium, and runs cooler than competitors.
- Price is $54.99 at Anker, with a $5 off promo showing on the page.
- **[Buy at Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)**
- Sources: [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)

## Thinnest and lightest overall: Baseus Picogo Air AM71
- Android Central's tester calls it the thinnest and lightest of the slim banks. It is 0.27" thick and 104g, with 5,000mAh.
- The catch is that wireless output is only 7.5W per their table. It also has 22.5W wired output, and it's $52.99 to $69.99 depending on the retailer.
- I don't have a direct store link for it, so check the retailer links in [Android Central's roundup](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge).

## Best slim 10,000mAh with 25W: INIU SnapGo Air
- It has 10,000mAh, 25W Qi2.2 wireless, and 45W wired charging. It is about 0.5" thick and 195g.
- It includes a built-in lanyard-style cable with a 60W cable, plus an LED display. It's listed at $42.99 on Amazon.
- Macworld rates it as one of the slimmest 10K MagSafe packs, and it has no kickstand.
- Buy links are in [Android Central's roundup](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge). See also [Macworld's guide](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html).

## Other options
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10K, 25W Qi2.2):** It's $53.99 with code AM52 on Baseus's US store, down from $59.99. No thickness is listed, so it may not be especially slim. The link below is an affiliate link, and the coupon claim comes from that deal site: [Baseus PicoGo AM52](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w).
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K, 15W):** It's 0.57" thick and has IP54 dust and water resistance, at about $70 to $80. It's more rugged than slim.
- **Skip the $24.99 Baseus 5K from 9to5Mac:** It isn't Qi2 and is limited to 7.5W wireless.

## My pick
- **Thin pocketable bank:** the Anker Nano 5K.
- **Two full charges and 25W speed:** the INIU SnapGo Air.

A 5K bank will only get you roughly 60 to 75% of a charge, per Macworld. Prices and promos change, so confirm at checkout.
